Step two of the sign-in form, in place: Finish in your browser, with Open browser again, Cancel and Use a code instead, or the device code with its countdown. A QR code appears only on TV and console. The step moves on by itself when the browser finishes. When it does not finish, the `denied` state (the person declined, `sign-in-denied`) is told apart from `failed` (anything else, `sign-in-failed`).

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `login --device-code`, and automatically over SSH, with no display or with `CI`: the code in reverse video, `c` copies it (OSC 52); never a QR in a terminal.

    **Styled part.** `screens.sign_in(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `SignInModel` (`prompted`, `use_code`, `tick`, `copied`, `finished`, `cancelled`) in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `login` (`loginFlow`) opens the browser and waits: Enter opens it again, `c` shows
    the code, Esc cancels. `login --device-code`, an SSH session, CI or Linux without a display show
    the code instead, with a countdown and `c` to copy it. No QR code. Under `--json` it streams
    `pending`, then the final state.

    **Styled part.** `codeRows` (the code in reverse video), `linkSpan` (an OSC 8 link) and
    `hintsRow`, with the `LiveRegion`, `spinnerFrames` and `osc52` primitives.

    **Headless.** `handoffView(state, data?)`: `starting`, `waiting`, `no-browser`, `code`,
    `link-copied`, `finishing`, `denied`, `failed`, `expired` or `cancelled`, with the URL, the code and the
    seconds left; `clock(seconds)` formats the countdown.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** Step 2 of the form: "Finish in your browser" with the system browser sheet, or the code view with Copy, the address with Copy and the countdown ring; no QR on iPhone or iPad (DL14).

    **Styled part.** `SignInHandoffView(screen:request:onCopyLink:)`, `CodeDisplay(code:)` and `CountdownRing(expiresAt:total:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.signInHandoff(_:)`; `KitSignInRequest` carries the public user code and pages, never the poll credential.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** Drawn by `<PolarisKeyGate>` when the license state calls for it, in the chrome of the OS.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<SignInHandoff />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("SignInHandoff", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** The gate shows the hand-off after Sign in: the code and its countdown, or Finish in your browser.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisSignInScreen(ui)` draws the hand-off, and `PolarisUserCode(code)` the code on its own. On Android TV the QR code leads and `onUseKey` offers a license key.

    **Headless.** `PolarisSignInUi` from `PolarisSignInState.ui`.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisSignInScreen
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisSignInUi

    @Composable
    fun MyHandoff(ui: PolarisSignInUi, cancel: () -> Unit, restart: () -> Unit) {
        PolarisSignInScreen(ui, onCancel = cancel, onRestart = restart)
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the one-liner, the sample and the routes; Compose Desktop opens the same screens in OS windows.

  </TabItem>
